name: tteeka
description: Uganda-first WhatsApp Commerce Operating System backend

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @tteeka/config && npm run build --workspace @tteeka/security && npm run build --workspace @tteeka/database && npm run build --workspace @tteeka/testing && npm run build --workspace @tteeka/api && npm run build --workspace @tteeka/worker
scripts.db:check: npm run build --workspace @tteeka/config && npm run build --workspace @tteeka/database && node --env-file-if-exists=.env packages/database/dist/check.js
scripts.pretest: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build --workspace @tteeka/config && npm run build --workspace @tteeka/security && npm run build --workspace @tteeka/database
